clusters.headline: Krakow Shooting Suspect Dies In Hospital Following Fatal Attack
aiSummaryBullets: The 24-year-old suspect, who allegedly killed six people in a Krakow market square, has died from injuries sustained during a shootout with police.
Polish authorities have initiated an investigation into the incident, formally classifying the event as a terrorist offense.

clusters.headline: Prime Minister Tusk Declares Krakow Shooting A Terrorist Attack
aiSummaryBullets: A total of nine people have been confirmed dead following the Krakow shooting incident and the subsequent discovery of bodies at the suspect's home.
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has officially designated the attack as an act of terrorism, noting the unprecedented nature of the event.
